literal: Possessing love, being born in a noble family, and possessing the good qualities desired by the king, are the qualities of one who delivers an embassy.
translation: An affectionate nature, birth in a noble family, and possessing the refined qualities esteemed by kings are the essential attributes of an envoy who delivers a message.
modern: அன்பு கொண்டிருத்தல், சிறந்த குடியில் பிறந்திருத்தல், அரசன் விரும்பும் நற்பண்புகளைப் பெற்றிருத்தல் ஆகிய இவை மூன்றும் தூது உரைப்பவனின் தகுதிகள் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the three fundamental qualities required of a successful envoy. First, they must possess genuine love and loyalty towards their own king and country. Second, they must come from an honorable and noble lineage, which gives them natural dignity and credibility. Third, they must possess the refined manners and pleasing qualities that kings appreciate, ensuring they can communicate effectively with foreign rulers.
